shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline | head; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; echo ---; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/ && sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts && sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ 2>/dev/null | head -3

grep -n '"@gravity-ui/icons"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; grep -n "theme\|iconStart\|iconEnd" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts | head; grep -n "ButtonView\b" -A6 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "export declare const Ellipsis\b\|export declare const Pencil\b\|export declare const TrashBin\b\|export declare const Copy\b\|export declare const ArrowShapeTurnUpRight\b\|export declare const ChevronDown\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts

sed -n 115,135p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -i "^Ellipsis\|^Pencil\|^TrashBin\|^Copy\.\|^ArrowShapeTurnUpRight\.\|^ChevronDown\." ; sed -n 1,5p node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts
node -p "require('@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version" && timeout 90 npm install --save --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund @gravity-ui/icons@2 2>&1 | tail -5; grep -n icons package.json

rm -rf dist && ls node_modules | grep -i "playwright\|jsdom\|happy-dom\|testing-library"; ls node_modules/@testing-library 2>/dev/null; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; git status --short
